clock: Raw positive odd-only map, no absorber; exact valuations and reduced denominators retained.

combined.scope: Comparable means B>0 and B/(q-1)>=1/4. It is a descriptive stratum, not a theorem hypothesis or evidence that other cases cannot violate the conjecture.

conjecture: For every simple positive raw odd cycle with reduced denominator q, q<=L and circular normalized successor order, B<=q-1.

existing.scope: Comparable means B>0 and B/(q-1)>=1/4. It is a descriptive stratum, not a theorem hypothesis or evidence that other cases cannot violate the conjecture.

scope: The finite test deliberately separates small-denominator near-bound cases from large-q passes. Logarithmic, half-linear, multiplicative-order and Euler-phi strengthenings are separate diagnostics, not adopted theorems. No scan establishes the absence of further cycles or any convergence claim.

small_parameter_census.interpretation: A deterministic bounded seed census at small additive parameters, with deeper scans at d5,7,11,13,29. Reduced denominators divide d. Every capped or unprocessed seed is unresolved; cycles outside the seed range may exist. Default replay reruns every processed seed, not only stored cycles.

new_normalized_summary.scope: Comparable means B>0 and B/(q-1)>=1/4. It is a descriptive stratum, not a theorem hypothesis or evidence that other cases cannot violate the conjecture.

parameters.memoization: Only paths already connected to an exactly closed cycle are memoized; capped paths are never memoized.

small_parameter_census.scope: Comparable means B>0 and B/(q-1)>=1/4. It is a descriptive stratum, not a theorem hypothesis or evidence that other cases cannot violate the conjecture.

status: Finite discrimination only. The conjecture remains unproved unless a separately checked counterexample is present.
